definitions.gloss: flood damage; water damage (from natural disaster)
definitions.explanation: Damage caused by flooding, heavy rain, storm surges, or other water-related natural disasters. Refers to the destruction itself rather than the water event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{水害|すいがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Flood damage occurred due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{水害|すいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされている→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。
examples.english: This area suffers from flood damage every year.

examples.japanese: {水害|すいがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{河川|かせん}→河川：13276_kasen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: River embankments were improved to prevent flood damage.

notes:
USAGE:
{水害|すいがい} specifically refers to damage caused by water from natural events like floods, typhoons, and heavy rains. Compare with ⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧ (flood), which refers to the flooding event itself, and ⟦{浸水|しんすい}→浸水：14945_shinsui⟧ (inundation), which describes the state of being submerged in water. Japan experiences frequent {水害|すいがい} during the rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧) and typhoon season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水害|すいがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: flood damage occurs
- {水害|すいがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent flood damage
- {水害|すいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to suffer flood damage
- {水害|すいがい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: flood damage countermeasures
- {水害|すいがい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: flood insurance
